# NFL Daily — 2026-11-15 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson suffered a significant knee injury celebrating a first-quarter sack of Drake Maye against the Patriots, and the team isn't expecting good news on his season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50491838/sources-lions-hutchinson-feared-significant-knee-injury)
- Patriots QB Drake Maye left the same game with an ankle injury on that play and will need further testing once the team returns from Germany. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50492387/patriots-qb-drake-maye-testing-ankle-injury)
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes played Sunday against the Falcons after the team brought in outside doctors to review his throwing elbow. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50481210/sources-baseball-doctors-consulted-patrick-mahomes-elbow)
- Bucs QB Baker Mayfield's availability for next week's game vs. the Lions is in question after a leg injury suffered over the bye. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50486637/sources-baker-mayfield-status-uncertain-vs-lions)
- Jets QB Geno Smith was ruled out with an ankle injury after briefly returning from a concussion evaluation; rookie Cade Klubnik finished the game in relief. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bills-geno-smith-injury-updates-bills-cade-klubnik/)
- Cardinals QB Gardner Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his throwing elbow and is expected to have season-ending surgery. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2121946608439103538)
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown left the Lions game with a hamstring injury and was ruled out. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/aj-brown-hamstring-injuury-update-patriots)
- 49ers set a high asking price for QB Mac Jones in trade talks with the Vikings. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/mac-jones-49ers-vikings-nfl-trade-rumors)

- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Rams WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is targeting a return Nov. 25 against the Packers. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
